miners.description: Advances one block of depth per second and starts with ordinary-stone capability only. Unsupported material stops the drill until the blocker is removed or an appropriate drill-bit skill is bought; otherwise it runs until it physically exits the current world.
Standalone wide-pattern content entry retained for data compatibility.
Starts as a deliberately dumb one-block-per-second terrain crawler. Sand and grass-edged dirt patches count as valid shovel terrain; skills add speed, slope sensing and longer-range scouting.
Skips soft terrain and specializes in stone, ore and gem blocks.
Moves between deterministic tree-bearing surface blocks and clears the tree together with its supporting block.
